situation-room.codes-intro: Type or paste codes, or upload the CSV file you were given, to see which are still unused. Only the codes are sent to Hawkeye — the rest of your file stays on this computer, and nothing is stored.
situation-room.codes-privacy: A used code shows the day it was used, never who used it. A code that is not your party’s, or does not exist, shows as “Not one of yours” — Hawkeye does not say which.
situation-room.codes-none-found: No codes found. A code looks like ORG-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
situation-room.codes-run-too-big: That is more than {v0} codes. Split the file and check it in parts.
situation-room.codes-file-too-big: That file is too large. Use a CSV of under 10 MB.
situation-room.codes-not-allowed: Only this room’s owner, or a coordinator named for your party, can check codes.
situation-room.codes-rate-limited: Too many checks in the last hour. Try again in {v0} minutes.
situation-room.codes-failed: Could not check the codes. Check your connection and try again.
situation-room.codes-results-pasted: Results for the codes you entered
situation-room.codes-shown: Showing the first {v0} of {v1} rows. The download has them all.
